title: Seoul, Tokyo Named Best Cities for Digital Nomads
paragraphs: Digital nomads are people who work online while they travel and live in different places. Which cities are the best for them? According to a new ranking, Seoul is number one, and Tokyo is a close second.

The ranking was made by vpn.jpn.com, a website that reviews VPN services, and it was reported in August 2026. The website looked at 104 of the world's largest cities and gave each one a score out of 100. It looked at things like the number of places to work, such as cafes, the number of places to go out, cultural places, internet speeds and prices. It also counted the number of days with comfortable weather for working.

Seoul was first, with a score of 73.60. It had the fastest internet in the top 10, and prices there were about 36% lower than in the United States. Tokyo was second, with 72.61. It had the most places to go out in the top 10, but it was a little more expensive than Seoul. Hanoi, in Vietnam, was third. It had the most places to work and very low prices, but its internet was slower.

Asian cities did very well in the ranking. Taipei was fourth, and Osaka was fifth. In fact, Japan had three cities in the top 10, because Nagoya was ninth. However, Nagoya had only 83 days with comfortable weather for working. Ho Chi Minh City, in Vietnam, was 10th.
The only European cities in the top 10 were Barcelona and Madrid, in sixth and seventh place. São Paulo, in Brazil, was eighth. It had the most days with nice weather in the top 10.
However, other rankings have had different results. For example, a ranking by the office company IWG in 2025 put Tokyo first. So, the best city depends on what people need.
